Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31454 of 2019

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant-Akash alias Supla has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application
seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 339 of 2018 (Session Trial No. 107 of 2019), under
Sections 498A, 304B, 201 Ipc and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Shahi, District Bareilly.
2.  This application is pending for about five years.
Sri Amit Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for applicant is not present.
3. Sri D.P.S. Chauhan, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant is husband, who is facing trial for offence of dowry death of his wife.
He further submits that at this stage present status of trial is not on record.
